summary: A person took back a campaign's standing approval for one category of reply, or its allowance for searches, so the work it covered waits for a decision again.

standing.description: A standing approval for one category of reply, as it was set.

category.description: The category of reply the standing approval covers.

operations.description: The operations it releases, in ordinal order.

expires_at.description: When it stops releasing work; null where it does not expire.

max_releases.description: How many releases it makes before it stops; null where it has no ceiling.

confined.description: Since 0.42.0, and only where it is so: it was set under the desktop's chat marker, as its set line says, and so had set nothing.

allowance.description: Since 0.36.0: the campaign's allowance for the searches under one of its audiences, as it was set.

category.description: An allowance covers searches, never a category of reply.

operations.description: `audience.search`, the one operation an allowance releases.

expires_at.description: When it stops releasing searches; null where it does not expire.

max_releases.description: How many searches it releases before it stops; null where it has no such ceiling.

audience.description: The campaign's audience whose searches it covers.

number.description: The number the campaign knows the audience by.

max_people.description: The most people the searches under it may ask for, added up.

max_per_search.description: The most people one search under it may ask for; null where it caps none.

confined.description: Since 0.42.0, and only where it is so: it was set under the desktop's chat marker, as its set line says, and so had set nothing.

key.description: The category of reply, which the campaign's newest line for it decides; since 0.36.0, `audience.search` on an allowance's line.

old.description: The standing approval taken back, as it was set: a category of reply's, as since 0.25.0, or since 0.36.0 the allowance's, a branch of its own, taken back by the person's unset, by a new allowance that replaces it, or by the person's approval of a search under another audience.
